svg.title: Where a $10,000 Recovery Goes Under Contingency
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-contingency-settlement-waterfall; chapter number: 3; chart type: waterfall; title: Where a $10,000 Recovery Goes Under Contingency; subtitle: Fee, expense, and lien deductions before the client is paid; caption: A $10,000 settlement at a 33.33 percent contingency, a $250 expense reimbursement, and a medical lien negotiated from $500 to $350 leave a $6,066.67 client disbursement.; assumptions note: Figures come from the LeanLaw SettleFlow demo; the $6,416.67 subtotal is arithmetic on those figures. Delegation cost varies, with receivers typically taking 25 percent per Hendershot Cowart and collection agencies taking a third per Private Investigator Videos.; note: Sources - LeanLaw (pmUaXhIL3eA), Hendershot Cowart P.C. (-kyDpaMUqFY), Private Investigator Videos (q-khGCaOPck).; bars: label: Gross Settlement; value: 10000.0; display: $10,000; kind: total; label: Contingency Fee at 33.33 Percent; value: 3333.33; display: -$3,333.33; kind: deduction; label: Expense Reimbursement; value: 250.0; display: -$250; kind: deduction; label: Net Before Lien; value: 6416.67; display: $6,416.67; kind: total; label: Medical Lien Negotiated From $500; value: 350.0; display: -$350; kind: deduction; label: Client Disbursement; value: 6066.67; display: $6,066.67; kind: result
